annotations.title: Inboxes and domains for a send volume (estimate)

description: Estimates how many inboxes and domains a daily cold email volume needs and the monthly cost at WarmInboxes' published prices. Inputs: emailsPerDay; optionally the provider (esp), prewarmed or fresh, billing cycle, emails per inbox per day and inboxes per domain. With dealValue (and optionally closeRate and positiveRate) it adds a revenue and ROI projection from those inputs. Assumes the provider's default daily pace per inbox unless emailsPerMailbox is given, and 22 sending days a month. The result is a planning estimate: it orders nothing, does not guarantee placement or replies, and its revenue figures follow only from the rates supplied.

billing.description: Prewarmed commitment length. Longer cycles are cheaper. Defaults to monthly. Google and Microsoft are billed per inbox; Azure is billed per tenant, flat, whatever is on the tenant.

closeRate.description: Percent of positive replies that close. Defaults to 10.

dealValue.description: Average deal size. Supply it to get replies, deals, revenue and ROI.

emailsPerDay.description: Target cold emails per day, e.g. 500.

emailsPerMailbox.description: Daily sends per inbox. Defaults to the platform's safe pace: 15 Google, 8 Microsoft, 2 Azure.

inboxesPerTenant.description: Fresh Azure only: how densely a tenant is packed. Also sets the pace, since a lighter tenant sends more per inbox (25/6, 50/4, 100/2). Defaults to 100.

mailboxesPerDomain.description: Fresh Google and Microsoft only. Defaults to 3.

positiveRate.description: Percent of sends that reply positively. Defaults to 1.

prewarmed.description: true for prewarmed inboxes (ready to send on delivery), false for fresh (14-21 day warmup, about a third the price). Defaults to true.

rotation.description: Rest half the fleet at any moment, which doubles the inboxes bought. Defaults to false.
